data: Only separately approved licensed, synthetic or redacted data with owner and retention record; raw DITA, chats, telemetry and web content are forbidden by default.
training: Separate stronger-machine, reproducible recipe and isolated environment.
release: Signed artifact, full compatibility manifest, six-locale comparison against base RAG, safety/resource gates and deterministic rollback to base model are mandatory.
shipping: No adapter ships until it beats the base stack on every required gate.
